_comment: The reason pass-2 normalised matching exists. Every record here has an answer the human genuinely picked from the list, stored with punctuation that no longer matches the option byte-for-byte because the question was re-asked with re-typed wording afterwards. C-01 reproduces the SHAPE of the live D-01 defect; it is hand-written, not copied from data/. C-AMBIGUOUS is the control: normalisation must refuse to guess.
